jurisdiction.venue: European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO), Rome & Court of Rome

docket_number: Court of Rome GIP Preventive Seizure Order (Nov. 27, 2026)
headline: E.P.P.O. Targets €14.5 Million Across Nine E.U. Nations in Alleged Italian Discount-Smartphone VAT Scheme
deck: Rome prosecutors and the Guardia di Finanza seized €2.2 million in real estate, luxury goods, cash, and bank accounts after alleging four companies and 11 suspects dumped unpaid VAT onto abandoned shell firms.

live_updates.text: Guardia di Finanza executes Court of Rome preventive seizure order targeting €14.5M across nine EU Member States.
Over €2.2M in real estate, luxury items, cash, and bank balances frozen across Italy, Romania, and seven partner states.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: At EPPO Rome’s request, the Court of Rome issued a preventive seizure order targeting €14.5 million across nine EU countries against four companies and 11 individuals suspected of evading VAT on discounted online mobile-phone sales and laundering the proceeds into luxury cars and real estate.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Undercutting neighborhood electronics shops by pocketing the sales tax at checkout, walking away from the storefront LLC when the tax bill arrives, and buying sports cars with the register
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Multi-year prison sentences under Italian tax-fraud and self-laundering statutes upon conviction; all 11 suspects remain presumed innocent

sources.title: Italy: EPPO investigates large-scale VAT fraud in the telecommunications sector

interactive_art_spec.caption: Palazzo di Giustizia in Rome, flying the Italian and European Union flags. At the request of E.P.P.O. Rome, Italian financial police executed a nine-country preventive seizure order targeting €14.5 million in alleged telecom VAT losses.
